description: In one call: closes every copied position at market and pauses copying. It does not revoke the trading key (only the wallet can, on Hyperliquid › API); resume_copying restarts copying.

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key (1 to 255 printable ASCII characters, for example a UUID): retrying with the same key and arguments within 24 hours returns the first answer and runs nothing again.

name: emergency_stop
title: Emergency stop
